title: Circular Permutation in Binary Representation

monster.name: Orbital Specter
monster.title: Rotator of the Gray Ring
monster.defeatQuote: Circular single-bit permutation starting from given start integer!

description: Given 2 integers `n` and `start`. A circular permutation `p` of length `2^n` satisfies: `p[0] == start`, adjacent elements differ by 1 bit, and first and last elements differ by 1 bit. Return the permutation.
starterCode:
def circularPermutation(n: int, start: int) -> list[int]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def circularPermutation(n: int, start: int) -> list[int]:
    return [start ^ (i ^ (i >> 1)) for i in range(1 << n)]
